description: smoke job env sets RETRIEVAL_MIN_SCORE to a non-number
find:
name: Import & route smoke tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
replace:
name: Import & route smoke tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RETRIEVAL_MIN_SCORE: "high"
notes: api/main.py calls get_settings() at import time, so the 'App imports on a clean machine' step fails with 'pydantic_core._pydantic_core.ValidationError: 1 validation error for Settings' / 'retrieval_min_score' / 'Input should be a valid number, unable to parse string as a number [type=float_parsing, input_value='high', input_type=str]'. CI stops at that step, so pytest never runs and there is no pytest summary. GitHub prints job-level env in the 'env:' block of each step header, so the log also shows 'RETRIEVAL_MIN_SCORE: high' above the failing step. The field name and input value point at configuration; config.py is unchanged, so the fix is the ci.yml env block.
